summary: Spyre Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting an October 5, 2026 underwriting agreement with Jefferies, TD Securities, Leerink and Stifel for a marketed follow-on equity offering of 4,117,648 common shares at $85.00 per share, plus a 30-day option for 617,647 additional shares, for about $350.0 million gross proceeds. Closing is expected on or about October 7, 2026, under an effective June 26, 2026 Form S-3 shelf. Proceeds fund gastroenterology, rheumatology and dermatology programs, Phase 3 readiness and SPY072 in hidradenitis suppurativa. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and dilution.
